app.name: PaperPaw plugin workshop
workshop.error.key: Anthropic did not accept the key. Check it and enter it again.
workshop.error.rate: Anthropic says too many requests at once. Wait a minute and send again.
workshop.error.network: Anthropic could not be reached. Check the connection and send again.
workshop.error.network.paperpaw: PaperPaw's key service (workshop.paperpaw.org) could not be reached. Check the connection and send again. If it goes on, the service may be down: try again later, or use a Claude key of your own.
workshop.error.key.paperpaw: PaperPaw's key service did not accept the key. Check that it was pasted whole, or ask for a new one on paperpaw.org/workshop.
workshop.error.server.paperpaw: PaperPaw's key service had a problem on its side. Send again in a moment, or use a Claude key of your own.
workshop.error.long: This conversation has become long, and longer ones cost more. Go on in a fresh one: your plugin's files and pictures stay, and the AI gets a short summary.
step.screenshot: Took a store screenshot on the {device}
workshop.checked: Checks: {n} to fix, given to the AI
provider.example: a recorded example: no key, no cost
share.problem.name: a name
share.problem.licence: what others may do with it
share.problem.tag: the tag "{tag}" in small letters, digits and hyphens
upload.refused.kind: {name} cannot be used: the workshop takes pictures (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, SVG), fonts (TTF, OTF) and texts.
upload.refused.large: {name} is larger than {mb} MB. Make it smaller first.
upload.refused.pixels: {name} has more than {mp} megapixels. Make it smaller first.
upload.refused.broken: {name} could not be read as a picture.
upload.refused.total: This plugin's uploads would take more than {mb} MB. Remove some in Files first.
workshop.error.billing: Your Anthropic account has no credit left. Add some in the Claude Console (Billing), then send again.
workshop.error.busy: Anthropic is overloaded right now. Wait a minute and send again.
workshop.error.server: Anthropic had a problem on its side. Send again in a moment.
workshop.error.reader: The reader is not ready yet. Wait a moment and try again.
upload.refused.count.one: This plugin has {n} upload already. Remove it in Files first.
upload.refused.count.other: This plugin has {n} uploads already. Remove some in Files first.
upload.refused.message.one: At most {n} at once: send this one first.
upload.refused.message.other: At most {n} at once: send these first.
upload.refused.shown.one: The AI can be shown only {n} more picture in this conversation. Leave some out, or go on in a fresh conversation.
upload.refused.shown.other: The AI can be shown only {n} more pictures in this conversation. Leave some out, or go on in a fresh conversation.
workshop.ppn.failed: It did not build for the {device}. Ask the AI to build it and fix what the compiler says.
workshop.ppn.builder: The builder is not running, so there is no package for the X4 (docker compose --profile code up).
workshop.ppn.device: PaperPaw on the {device} takes plugins with code later. Show the X4 or the X4 Pro to download it for them.
steps.list_files: Looked at the plugin's files ({n} times)
steps.set_fixtures: Recorded answers for its requests ({n} times)
step.control.widget: Put it on the home screen
step.control.wait.change: Waited for the screen to change
steps.control.widget: Put it on the home screen ({n} times)
